ukberi-tibyan:10-10.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (فَارْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِي السَّمَاءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُبِينٍ (١٠)).
His saying (يَوْمَ تَأْتِي): it is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of فَارْتَقِبْ.

ukberi-tibyan:11-13.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (يَغْشَى النَّاسَ هَذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ (١١) رَبَّنَا اكْشِفْ عَنَّا الْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ (١٢) أَنَّى لَهُمُ الذِّكْرَى وَقَدْ جَاءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُبِينٌ (١٣)).
His saying (هَذَا عَذَابٌ): i.e. it is said: "this…". And (الذِّكْرَى) is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «لَهُمْ» is the khabar (predicate). And (أَنَّى) is an adverb governed by [the notion of] settledness (al-istiqrār).
It is also possible that «أَنَّى» is the khabar and «لَهُمْ» is for clarification (tabyīn).
(وَقَدْ جَاءَهُمْ): a ḥāl (circumstantial).

ukberi-tibyan:15-16.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا الْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُمْ عَائِدُونَ (١٥) يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ الْبَطْشَةَ الْكُبْرَى إِنَّا مُنْتَقِمُونَ (١٦)).
And (قَلِيلًا): i.e. "for a little time", or "a little removal". And (يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ): it is said: it is a badal (substitute) of [يَوْمَ] تَأْتِي. It is also said: it is an adverb of time for عَائِدُونَ. It is also said: the implied wording is "remember". It is also said: it is an adverb of time for what the speech indicates, i.e. "We shall take vengeance on the day We strike".
It is also read «نُبْطِشُ», with ḍamma on the nūn and kasra on the ṭāʾ; one says أَبْطَشْتُهُ when you enable him to strike; i.e. "We shall enable the angels to strike".

ukberi-tibyan:18-18.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (أَنْ أَدُّوا إِلَيَّ عِبَادَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ (١٨)).
His saying (عِبَادَ اللَّهِ): i.e. "O servants of Allah", i.e. render to me what is due from you.
It is also said: it is the object of أَدُّوا, i.e. "leave me free with those who have believed in me".

ukberi-tibyan:20-22.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (وَإِنِّي عُذْتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمْ أَنْ تَرْجُمُونِ (٢٠) وَإِنْ لَمْ تُؤْمِنُوا لِي فَاعْتَزِلُونِ (٢١) فَدَعَا رَبَّهُ أَنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ قَوْمٌ مُجْرِمُونَ (٢٢)).
(وَإِنِّي عُذْتُ): resumptive. And (أَنْ تَرْجُمُونِ): i.e. "from your stoning me" (مِنْ أَنْ تَرْجُمُونِ).
And (أَنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ) is accusative by «دَعَا».
It is also read with kasra (إِنَّ), because دَعَا has the sense of قَالَ ("said").

ukberi-tibyan:24-28.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (وَاتْرُكِ الْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا إِنَّهُمْ جُنْدٌ مُغْرَقُونَ (٢٤) كَمْ تَرَكُوا مِنْ جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ (٢٥) وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ (٢٦) وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا فِيهَا فَاكِهِينَ (٢٧) كَذَلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَاهَا قَوْمًا آخَرِينَ (٢٨)).
And (رَهْوًا) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الْبَحْرَ, i.e. "still".
It is also said: it is a second object, i.e. "make it [so]".
And (كَمْ) is accusative by «تَرَكُوا». And (كَذَلِكَ): i.e. "the matter is thus". It is also said: the implied wording is "a leaving like that".

ukberi-tibyan:3-3.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةٍ مُبَارَكَةٍ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنْذِرِينَ (٣)).
His saying (إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَاهُ): it is the answer to the oath. And «إِنَّا كُنَّا» is resumptive.
It is also said: it is another answer, without a conjunction.

ukberi-tibyan:30-32.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ الْمُهِينِ (٣٠) مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِنَ الْمُسْرِفِينَ (٣١) وَلَقَدِ اخْتَرْنَاهُمْ عَلَى عِلْمٍ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ (٣٢)).
His saying (مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَ): it is a badal (substitute) of «الْعَذَابِ» with the preposition repeated, i.e. "from the punishment of Pharaoh"; it may also be that Pharaoh himself is made a punishment.
And (مِنَ الْمُسْرِفِينَ) is a further khabar (predicate), or a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «عَالِيًا».
And (عَلَى عِلْمٍ) is a ḥāl of the agent pronoun, i.e. "We chose them, knowing them"; and «عَلَى» [in عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ] is attached (mutaʿalliq) to اخْتَرْنَا.

ukberi-tibyan:37-38.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَالَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ أَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا مُجْرِمِينَ (٣٧) وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَاعِبِينَ (٣٨)).
His saying (وَالَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ): it may be conjoined to «قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ», so that «أَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ» is resumptive, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in the ṣila (relative clause). It may also be a mubtadaʾ (subject), the khabar (predicate) being أَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ; or accusative by an omitted verb. And (لَاعِبِينَ) is a ḥāl.

ukberi-tibyan:4-4.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ (٤)).
His saying (فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ): it is resumptive.
It is also said: it is a naʿt (adjective) of لَيْلَةٍ, and «إِنَّا...» is parenthetical between the two.

ukberi-tibyan:40-41.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (إِنَّ يَوْمَ الْفَصْلِ مِيقَاتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ (٤٠) يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِي مَوْلًى عَنْ مَوْلًى شَيْئًا وَلَا هُمْ يُنْصَرُونَ (٤١)).
And (أَجْمَعِينَ) is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the genitive pronoun. (يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِي): it may be a badal (substitute) of (يَوْمَ الْفَصْلِ); or a naʿt (adjective) of «مِيقَاتُهُمْ», but made indeclinable (mabnī); or an adverb of time for what الْفَصْلِ indicates, i.e. "He will judge between them on the day when … will not avail". It is not attached to الْفَصْلِ itself, because a predicate has been given about it.

ukberi-tibyan:42-42.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (إِلَّا مَنْ رَحِمَ اللَّهُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ (٤١)) [Translator's note: so in the text; this is verse ٤٢].
His saying (إِلَّا مَنْ رَحِمَ): it is a connected exception (istithnāʾ muttaṣil), i.e. "whomever Allah has mercy on by accepting intercession for him".
It may also be a badal (substitute) of the object of يَنْصُرُونَ, i.e. "they will not help anyone except whom Allah has mercy on".

ukberi-tibyan:45-47.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (كَالْمُهْلِ يَغْلِي فِي الْبُطُونِ (٤٥) كَغَلْيِ الْحَمِيمِ (٤٦) خُذُوهُ فَاعْتِلُوهُ إِلَى سَوَاءِ الْجَحِيمِ (٤٧)).
His saying (يَغْلِي): it is read with yāʾ. It may be a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in the kāf, i.e. "it resembles molten metal, boiling". It is also said: it is a ḥāl of الْمُهْلِ. It is also said: the implied wording is "it boils", i.e. the Zaqqūm or the food.
As for the kāf, it may be a second khabar (predicate), or on the implied wording "it is like molten metal". It cannot be a ḥāl of «طَعَامُ», because there would then be nothing to govern it.
It is also read with tāʾ (تَغْلِي), i.e. the tree; and the kāf is in the position of the accusative, i.e. "a boiling like the boiling of scalding water".
(فَاعْتِلُوهُ): with kasra on the tāʾ and with ḍamma on it — two dialectal forms.

ukberi-tibyan:49-57.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْكَرِيمُ (٤٩) إِنَّ هَذَا مَا كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تَمْتَرُونَ (٥٠) إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ (٥١) فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ (٥٢) يَلْبَسُونَ مِنْ سُنْدُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُتَقَابِلِينَ (٥٣) كَذَلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَاهُمْ بِحُورٍ عِينٍ (٥٤) يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَاكِهَةٍ آمِنِينَ (٥٥) لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا الْمَوْتَ إِلَّا الْمَوْتَةَ الْأُولَى وَوَقَاهُمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ (٥٦) فَضْلًا مِنْ رَبِّكَ ذَلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ (٥٧)).
His saying (ذُقْ إِنَّكَ): «إِنَّكَ» is read with kasra, as resumptive, and it is mockery of him; it is also said [it means]: "you are the mighty, the noble, in the eyes of your people". It is also read with fatḥa (أَنَّكَ), i.e. "taste the punishment of your being…".
And (مَقَامٍ), with fatḥa and with ḍamma (مُقَامٍ), has been mentioned in al-Aḥzāb. And (فِي جَنَّاتٍ) is a badal (substitute) of «مَقَامٍ» with the preposition repeated.
As for «يَلْبَسُونَ», it may be the khabar (predicate) of إِنَّ, so that «فِي» is attached (mutaʿalliq) to it; or a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in the preposition phrase; or resumptive. And (كَذَلِكَ): i.e. "Our doing is thus", or "the matter is thus".
And (يَدْعُونَ) is a ḥāl of the agent in زَوَّجْنَا [Translator's note: so in the text; the agent of زَوَّجْنَا is "We", and the intended reference is evidently the object pronoun هُمْ]. And (لَا يَذُوقُونَ) is another ḥāl, of the pronoun in يَدْعُونَ or of the pronoun in آمِنِينَ; or another ḥāl after آمِنِينَ; or a naʿt (adjective) of آمِنِينَ. His saying (إِلَّا الْمَوْتَةَ الْأُولَى): it is said that the exception is disconnected (munqaṭiʿ), i.e. "they died the death".
It is also said: it is connected (muttaṣil), because the believer at his death in this world is as if in his station in the Garden, since he sees what he is given of it, or what he becomes certain of of its bliss. It is also said: «إِلَّا» has the sense of "after". It is also said: it has the sense of "other than". And (فَضْلًا) is a maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "We bestowed that as a favour". And Allah knows best.

ukberi-tibyan:5-5.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (أَمْرًا مِنْ عِنْدِنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ (٥)).
His saying (أَمْرًا): there are several views on its accusative. The first: it is the object of مُنْذِرِينَ, like His saying (لِيُنْذِرَ بَأْسًا شَدِيدًا). The second: it is a mafʿūl lahu (object of purpose), governed by «أَنْزَلْنَاهُ» or «مُنْذِرِينَ» or «يُفْرَقُ». The third: it is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «حَكِيمٍ», or of «أَمْرٍ» because it has been qualified, or of كُلُّ, or of the hāʾ in أَنْزَلْنَاهُ. The fourth: that it is in the position of the maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "a separating from Us". The fifth: that it is a maṣdar, i.e. "We commanded a commanding", indicated by the commands the Book contains. The sixth: that it is a badal (substitute) of the hāʾ in «أَنْزَلْنَاهُ».
As for (مِنْ عِنْدِنَا), it may be a naʿt (adjective) of أَمْرًا, or attached (mutaʿalliq) to يُفْرَقُ.

ukberi-tibyan:6-6.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (رَحْمَةً مِنْ رَبِّكَ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ (٦)).
His saying (رَحْمَةً): there are several views on it. The first: that it is the object of «مُرْسِلِينَ», what is meant by it being the Prophet ﷺ.
The second: that it is a mafʿūl lahu (object of purpose). The third: that it is a maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "We had mercy on you with a mercy".
The fourth: that it is in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «مُرْسِلِينَ»; and it is best that the implied wording be "possessed of mercy".

ukberi-tibyan:7-7.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُوقِنِينَ (٧)).
His saying (رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ): in the nominative (رَبُّ) on the implied wording "He is the Lord"; or as a mubtadaʾ (subject), the khabar (predicate) being «لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ»; or as a khabar after a khabar. And in the genitive as a badal (substitute) of «رَبِّكَ».

ukberi-tibyan:8-8.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ آبَائِكُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ (٨)).
His saying (رَبُّكُمْ): i.e. "He is your Lord". It may also be a further khabar (predicate), or the fāʿil (agent) of «يُمِيتُ», with a pronoun in «يُحْيِي» referring to what precedes it, or on the condition of explanation (ʿalā sharīṭat al-tafsīr) [i.e. the pronoun anticipating the noun that follows].
